title: Red-haired giant remains in American mountains came with the Phoenicians
summary: Tim Alberino tells of Red-haired giant remains in American mountains came with the Phoenicians, about 1800s–early 1900s finds at United States (no place named), and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: controversial I think that the reason why you find red-haired giants, >> the remains of redhaired giants in the mountains of America back in the the uh 18 and early 1900s is because they came over >> the sea with the phoenetians.

plain: A filmmaker and researcher named Tim Alberino, speaking with podcast host Jesse Michels, says that in the 1800s and early 1900s the remains of red-haired giants were found in the mountains of America. His own explanation, which he admits is controversial, is that these giants came across the sea with the Phoenicians, an ancient seafaring people of the eastern Mediterranean. If true, it would mean ancient travellers reached America long before Columbus.
